purpose: Identify source-native archival holdings capable of supporting pre-1968 EVENT records before filling historical stress-corpus slots.
slot_policy: Do not assign a pre-1968 EVENT slot merely because an archival institution exists; first identify an individual occurrence in the archival material or a source-specific finding aid.

targets.relevance: primary judicial archival route for pre-1968 criminal proceedings within historical Nicastro

targets.territorial_scope: Sambiase and historical mandamento including Gizzeria and Platania
targets.relevance: judicial source route for historical Sambiase; territorial competence must be checked per record

targets.institution: Sistema Archivistico Nazionale / Archivio di Stato
targets.relevance: higher-level criminal/civil judicial archive locator for cases beyond pretura competence

targets.institution: Archivio di Stato di Catanzaro - Sezione di Lamezia Terme
targets.relevance: local conservation institution and acquisition/contact route

research_protocol: Start from Pretura/Tribunale finding aids and inventories rather than free-text web anecdotes.
Record series, busta/fascicolo/registro and chronological span before creating an EVENT candidate.
Use event date/place from the archival record; do not substitute later historiography when the original record is available.
Historic place identity must remain Nicastro/Sambiase/Sant'Eufemia as source-stated, with a separate relation to present-day Lamezia Terme.
No historical EVENT is mappable from an archive-level locator alone.

cycle_2_result.next_action: Locate inventory/series-level descriptions or digitized records for a specific criminal proceeding before assigning the first pre-1968 stress-corpus EVENT.
